description: Read one person's Action Center items from OpenVibe.Domains (plan 2026-10-28 §3.10, §5.1): their DNS change proposals (waiting for approval, applied, failed or rolled back in the last 30 days), as common.action-list-result@1. GET /api/v1/actions?subject=usr_… with a service token; granted to OpenVibe.Network's aggregator only. Never another person's items, never a credential, and only the fields of common.action-item@1.
